subheading: Generate instrumental music, loops, and sound effects from text using open ComfyUI workflows built on Stable Audio and ACE-Step.
extendedDescription:
An ai music generator is most useful when you can shape the output instead of pulling a slot machine lever. The workflows on this page run open audio models inside ComfyUI, where every parameter is a node you can see and change. The featured Music Generator, built on Stable Audio 3, produces stereo music, instruments, sound effects, and one-shots from a text prompt with direct control over the duration.

The cluster covers the range of music jobs. Stable Audio 3.0 Medium handles broad text-to-audio generation. The ACE-Step 1.5 workflows focus on structured music generation, including a 4B LLM variant that interprets loose descriptions into fuller arrangements and a turbo variant for fast iteration. The instrumentals workflow generates melody-forward tracks without vocals, and Seed Audio covers general text-to-audio for effects and ambience.

Because these are ComfyUI graphs, you can chain them: generate a track, then feed it into an audio-reactive video workflow, or batch-generate ten variations of the same brief and keep the best. Everything runs on Comfy Cloud in the browser with no install, or locally in your own ComfyUI, and exports standard audio files with no watermark.

howToUse: Pick the workflow that fits the job: Stable Audio for broad generation, ACE-Step for structured music, the instrumentals workflow for melody without vocals.
Open it on Comfy Cloud with the Try button, or load it in your local ComfyUI.
Describe the music in the prompt: genre, instruments, mood, and tempo.
Set the duration for the clip you need, from a one-shot to a full track.
Run it, audition the result, and re-run with an adjusted prompt or seed until it fits.
Export the audio file, or wire the output into another workflow such as an audio-reactive video.

metaDescription: Generate instrumental music, loops, and sound effects from text with Stable Audio and ACE-Step workflows in ComfyUI. Duration control, stereo output, no install.

faqItems.question: What can these workflows generate?
faqItems.answer: Stereo music, individual instruments, sound effects, and one-shot samples from a text description, with the clip duration set by you.

faqItems.question: Which models power this page?
faqItems.answer: The workflows use Stable Audio 3 and the ACE-Step 1.5 family, plus Seed Audio for general text-to-audio. All run as open ComfyUI workflows.

faqItems.question: Can I make music without vocals?
faqItems.answer: Yes. The instrumentals workflow and the Stable Audio workflows generate music without vocals. For songs with singing, use the AI song generator page.

faqItems.question: Can I control how long the music is?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Duration is a workflow input, so you can generate anything from a short one-shot to a full-length track.

faqItems.question: Do I need a powerful computer?
faqItems.answer: No. The Try buttons run every workflow on Comfy Cloud in the browser. Running locally is optional and uses your own GPU.
